name: Cristián Aninat
transfer_hypotheses: Test whether the scene reads as a visual story without explanatory rescue.
counterexamples: His public practice spans portraiture, culture, branding, and architecture; no single mechanism predicts contest judgment.

name: Hans Stoll
transfer_hypotheses: Test formal order, material/light legibility, and whether reduction strengthens the scene.
counterexamples: His practice includes portraiture, landscape, collage, and photo-sculpture; meaningful absence is not a universal judging rule.

name: Camilo Monzón
transfer_hypotheses: Test whether changing viewpoint reveals a real architectural relationship hidden from the default position.
counterexamples: Aerial work does not imply a drone preference, and contest legality/access/one-frame coherence dominate.
